## Detailed checklist

<!-- Generated by npm run spec:report from test/spec-coverage.json. -->

Tracked glTF static rendering behaviors, not an exhaustive normative-clause inventory or certification.

This checklist tracks **41 behaviors**: **31 implemented**, **5 partial**, **5 unsupported**, **0 unverified**. These counts are not a percentage of the glTF specification, code coverage, or Khronos certification. Rows vary in scope and are not weighted.

Implemented means the named behavior has implementation and targeted regression evidence. Partial means known limits remain. Unsupported means rendering is absent, even when its diagnostic is tested. Unverified means code exists but targeted correctness evidence is missing. None implies exhaustive testing of every valid input.

The offline reference suite contains **16 assets**, pinned to [Khronos glTF Sample Assets revision 8f492390ddc7](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/8f492390ddc7a2ae221a1369ef560589cf8c70fb). Source and vendored hashes are recorded in [test/reference-assets.json](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/test/reference-assets.json); attribution is in [test/fixtures/NOTICE.md](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/test/fixtures/NOTICE.md). External resources are embedded in text fixtures, then buffers are repacked into one GLB for tests. This does not exercise external resource loading.

Every reference is validated before and after repacking with glTF Validator, then rendered from two views with nonempty-output, deterministic-output and expected-diagnostic assertions. These are smoke tests, not reference-image comparisons. Validator results concern asset validity, not renderer conformance.

Run `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `cargo test` for executable evidence. Run `npm run spec:check` to verify checklist references, pinned fixture hashes and generated documentation; it does not execute the tests. CI runs all four. `npm run spec:report` updates this page and writes `build/spec-coverage.json`, which records inventory counts without claiming a test run passed.

### GLB-01

**Chunk framing, ordering and unknown trailing chunks: implemented.** [Specification](https://registry.khronos.org/glTF/specs/2.0/glTF-2.0.html#glb-file-format-specification).

Implementation: [src/core/gltf/mod.rs](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/src/core/gltf/mod.rs).

Targeted regression evidence:

- [GLB ignores unknown trailing chunks and rejects invalid chunk layout](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/test/spec-behavior.test.mjs)

### ASSET-01

**Major/minor version and minimum version negotiation: implemented.** [Specification](https://registry.khronos.org/glTF/specs/2.0/glTF-2.0.html#asset).

Implementation: [src/core/gltf/mod.rs](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/src/core/gltf/mod.rs).

Targeted regression evidence:

- [asset versions honor minor forward compatibility and minimum requirements](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/test/spec-behavior.test.mjs)

### RESOURCE-01

**Buffer resource loading: partial.** [Specification](https://registry.khronos.org/glTF/specs/2.0/glTF-2.0.html#buffers-and-buffer-views).

Implementation: [src/core/gltf/mod.rs](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/src/core/gltf/mod.rs).

Reference smoke tests: [BoxInterleaved](https://github.com/pcbjs/renderer/blob/main/test/fixtures/BoxInterleaved.gltf).

Limitations: One embedded GLB buffer only. External and data URI buffers and multiple buffers are unsupported; reference tests repack buffers before loading.
